description: Listed Building Consent for change of use of House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) to a single family house, erection of a single storey side extension, single storey rear infill extension and rear dormer extension to the original single storey rear outrigger, replacement first floor rear balustrades, two rear rooflights, replacement front boundary gates and various internal alterations.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A689 03 (Rev A)  Received:  16 March 2021;  A689 01; A689 02; A689 04; A689 05; A689 20; A689 21; A689 22; A689 23; A689 M01; A689 M02; A689 M03; A689 M04; A689 M05; Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  16 February 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
